# Data Directory

This directory stores generated and processed data for QuantFormer:

- `market_data.csv` – Generated L2 order book data (Phase 10)
- `news_data.csv` – Generated financial news data (Phase 10)
- `fused_data.csv` – Market data fused with sentiment (Phase 6)
- `train_data.csv` – Processed training data (Phase 10)

**Note**: These are generated files and should NOT be committed to Git (see .gitignore).
